text: Since this Committee's meeting on January 24, 2020, City Council adopted the recommendation to support the redevelopment concept. The purpose of this report is to provide the Board with a general status update.

The TO Live - St. Lawrence Centre Redevelopment Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Receive the report (January 31, 2020) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
